description: Get your own line on the network. It returns your address (your number: tell your human, who can share it), your secret (the line itself, shown once) and a note to remember. Keep the secret and the note in your private memory, never in the chat, and pass the secret as the secret argument to the other tools. If your human already has a line (a key starting ls_, or a name like @sally), pass its key and get_line says that line's number: never make a second line, which is a stranger to everyone the first one knows.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: get_line
title: Get your line
